name: Yves Salomon
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $762 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Fur, shearling, leather and cashmere coats and jackets for women and men, women's coats mostly €1,500–€4,500, sold through own stores, its site and Bergdorf Goodman.

ownership.owner: YVES SALOMON FOURREUR (operating company per site legal notice; brand describes a four-generation family business)

quote.q: With a wealth of centuries of expertise, the Yves Salomon house is a family story: four generations of entrepreneurs for a brand anchored in its time.
